Material: OTHER OIL - LIGHT GAS OIL, CAT CRACKER FEED, NAPTHA,
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: SHELL REFINERY
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 10500 gallons
CALLER REPORTED THAT WITHIN AN EXCAVATION SITE AT THE REFINERY'S TANK FARM SOME PIPING HAD BEEN CUT AND PLUGGED BY WORKERS ON THE DAYSHIFT. IT'S SUSPECTED THAT ONE OF THESE PLUGS MAY HAVE COME LOOSE CAUSING MATERIAL TO FILL THE PIT (PIT DIMENSIONS ARE APPROX. 5 FEET DEEP BY 40 FEET LONG AND 20 FEET WIDE) THE MATERIAL EVENTUALLY OVERFILLED THE PIT AND RAN INTO A STORM WATER DITCH WHICH LEADS TO THE HOUSTON SHIP CHANNEL. THE DITCH IS A PERMITTED OUTFALL AND BECAUSE OF THE WEIRS AND GATES IN PLACE WITHIN DITCH NO MATERIAL HAS GONE OFFSITE. CALLER IS UNSURE WHAT THE MATERIAL IS BECAUSE THERE ARE MANY PIPES THAT RUN THROUGH THE AREA. THE MATERIAL IS DESCRIBED AS BEING A LIGHT GAS OIL OR CAT CRACKER FEED. IT SMELLS A LITTLE LIKE NAPTHA AND APPEARS TO CONTAIN A WAXY SUBSTANCE.

CALLER IS REPORTING THAT WHEN HE CAME BACK HOME FROM A TRIP HIS VESSEL WAS CAPSIZED AND SUBMERGED. THERE WAS NO SHEEN ON THE WATER. WHEN HE SPOKE WITH HIS NEIGHBOR, HIS NEIGHBOR STATED THAT ON 30-JUN-2007 AT 0132 HE WOKE UP TO LOUD MOTORS AND RAN OUTSIDE. HE THEN WITNESSED A WAKE COMING OVER THE SEA WALL WHICH IS 4-5 FEET TALL. Report Details

Location2: MANUFACTURING PLANT

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.853162, -96.646034 (Approximated from premise)
Reported Sheen Size: 15 feet by 40 feet (area 600 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 625 gallon
SkyTruth Minimum Estimate: 0.01 gallons
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS A CHEMICAL MIXER MALFUNCTIONED, DISCHARGING 625 GALLONS OF HEPTANE (MAIN COMPONENT OF A PRODUCT CALLED "KINJALE") INTO A CONCRETE CONTAINMENT. THIS MALFUNCTION ALSO CAUSED AN UNKNOWN QUANTITY OF A CEMENT PRODUCT (A HEPTANE, TOLUENE, BARSOL D-100, METHYL ETHYL KETONE MIXTURE) TO BE DISCHARGED. THE TOTAL QUANTITY OF CEMENT RELEASED IS BELIEVED TO BE LESS THAN THE PURE "KINJALE" (HEPTANE) PRODUCT. AN UNKNOWN QUANTITY OF THE "KINJALE" HAS REACHED AN OUTFALL TO SALT CREEK, BUT HOW EXACTLY THIS IS OCCURRING IS UNKNOWN. THIS CONTAINMENT AREA WAS NOT BELIEVED TO HAVE A DRAIN. THE ENTIRE VISIBLE PORTION OF THE CREEK HAS A RED SHEEN/DISCOLORATION (40 FT X 15 FT). THE LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT/HAZMAT CREW/HEALTH DEPARTMENT ARE ON-SCENE RESPONDING. IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE RELEASE IS SECURED. 200 EMPLOYEES HAVE BEEN EVACUATED, AND THE STREET GOING TO THE FACILITY IS CLOSED.

Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ON 11/04/2013 AT 1809 HOURS,CSX MANAGER ENVIRONMENTAL FIELD SERVICES, REPORTED APPROXIMATELY EIGHT TO TEN GALLONS OF LUBE-OIL LEAKED ONTO TRACK BALLAST FROM LOCOMOTIVE CSXT 15158 NEAR MP QC 147.0 ON THE SELKIRK SUBDIVISON. THIS IS LOCATED ON THE WEST END OF THE DIESEL SHOP ON TRACK 5, WITHIN THE SELKIRK YARD AT ONE BELL CROSSING ROAD IN SELKIRK, NY. CALLER ADDED THAT THE LOCOMOTIVE HAD SYPHONED LUBE-OIL UP THROUGH THE TURBO-CHARGER AND LEAKED / SPRAYED IT ON THE TRACKS. MOST OF THE OIL WAS SOPPED UP BUY TRACK MATTING. NO WATERWAYS HAD BEEN AFFECTED AND THE WEATHER WAS CLEAR SKIES IN THE LOW 30'S. CSX CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS / HAZARDOUS MATERIALS MANAGER, WAS CONFERENCED IN WITH CALLER, AND ADVISED ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTORS WOULD BE NOTIFIED AND RESPONDING FOR CLEAN-UP. DISPATCHER PRESCOTT, BETHLEHEM POLICE DEPARTMENT, WAS ALSO NOTIFIED, AND ADVISED NO RESPONSE WAS NEEDED.
